comparison.comparison: Every source row, identifier, timestamp and interval cell independently compared with original openpyxl values; no SDK parsing helpers used for expected values.

fixture.selection: All series on January 1, March 8 (short day), March 9, and July 31, 2026. Original cell XML retained, rows removed and coordinates renumbered; source dimension preserved.

limitations: Direct workbook only; MIS feeds not queried. No older history inferred from URL dates.
STARTTIME and LSTIME retain source values, with no inferred timezone or proof of public availability.
100 original interval positions retained. Numeric factors are unscaled and never applied implicitly.
